title: Superior solubility of anhydrous quercetin and polymer physical mixtures compared to amorphous solid dispersions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9348-9358
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08796H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xu Ma, Hong Su, Yongming Liu, Fenghua Chen, Rongrong Xue
Physical mixtures (PMs) of anhydrous quercetin (QUE-AH) and PVP or soluplus shows higher solubility compared with the corresponding ASDs of QUE. The gel-like phase separation occurring during the ASDs dissolution process was avoided in the PMs.
